mapper.sql:
p.IPROM_NO, p.SGUBUN_ID, p.ICATE_NO, p.IGAEJUNG_NO, p.ILAW_ID, p.ILAW_NO, p.IBUSEO_NO, p.SBUSEO_ORGNZT_ID, p.SSYS_ID, p.STITLE, p.SSUB_TITLE, p.SNUM, p.SPARTY,
p.SPROM_DT, p.SSTART_DT, p.SNULL_DT, p.SNULL_DT_PEND, SUBSTR(p.SINS_DT, 1, 16) AS SINS_DT, p.SREASON, p.SGAEJUNG, p.SBYLAW, p.SPREAMBLE, p.SSEARCH_TEXT, p.SURL, p.SPROV_FG, p.SPROV_STYLE_CD, p.SPROV_FILE_NO, p.SDISP_YN, p.SEXISTING_YN, p.SEXT_DISP_YN, p.SDPL_ITEM_YN, p.SREL_FILE_VIEW_YN, p.SSTSFDG_YN, p.SSTATUS, p.ISEQ, p.SORDERIDX
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_PROM p LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CATE c ON p.ICATE_NO = c.ICATE_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTNORGNZTINFO b ON b.ORGNZT_ID = COALESCE(p.SBUSEO_ORGNZT_ID, 'ORG_' || LPAD(CAST(p.IBUSEO_NO AS text), 16, '0')) WHERE p.SEXISTING_YN = 'Y'
AND p.ICATE_NO = #{cateNo}
AND p.SGUBUN_ID = #{gubunId}
AND UPPER(p.STITLE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) || '%'
AND STRPOS(p.SSEARCH_TEXT, #{searchKeyword}) > 0
AND UPPER(c.SNAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) || '%'
AND UPPER(b.ORGNZT_NM) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) || '%'
AND UPPER(p.STITLE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) || '%'

SELECT , c.SNAME AS CATE_NM, GET_FULL_NAME_BY_CATE_NO('NONE', p.ICATE_NO) AS CATE_FULL_NM, b.ORGNZT_NM AS BUSEO_NM, g.SNAME AS GAEJUNG_NM FROM TB_PROM p LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CATE c ON p.ICATE_NO = c.ICATE_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTNORGNZTINFO b ON b.ORGNZT_ID = COALESCE(p.SBUSEO_ORGNZT_ID, 'ORG_' || LPAD(CAST(p.IBUSEO_NO AS text), 16, '0')) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_GAEJUNG g ON p.IGAEJUNG_NO = g.IGAEJUNG_NO WHERE p.IPROM_NO = #{promNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_PROM SET SNULL_DT_PEND = #{pend,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE IPROM_NO = #{promNo}
UPDATE TB_PROM SET SNULL_DT = SNULL_DT_PEND, SNULL_DT_PEND = NULL WHERE IPROM_NO = #{promNo} AND SNULL_DT_PEND IS NOT NULL
UPDATE TB_PROM SET SNULL_DT_PEND = NULL WHERE IPROM_NO = #{promNo} AND SNULL_DT_PEND IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: SELECT , NULL AS CATE_NM, NULL AS CATE_FULL_NM, NULL AS BUSEO_NM, g.SNAME AS GAEJUNG_NM, ( SELECT w.SSTATUS FROM TB_PROM_WRK w WHERE w.IPROM_NO = p.IPROM_NO AND w.IPWRK_NO = ( SELECT MAX(w2.IPWRK_NO) FROM TB_PROM_WRK w2 WHERE w2.IPROM_NO = p.IPROM_NO ) ) AS WORK_STATUS FROM TB_PROM p LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_GAEJUNG g ON p.IGAEJUNG_NO = g.IGAEJUNG_NO WHERE p.ILAW_ID = #{lawId} ORDER BY p.ILAW_NO DESC, p.IPROM_NO DESC

SELECT p.ILAW_NO FROM TB_PROM p WHERE p.ILAW_ID = #{lawId} AND COALESCE(p.SEXISTING_YN, 'N') = 'N' AND COALESCE(p.SDISP_YN, 'Y') != 'N' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_PROM_WRK dw WHERE dw.IPROM_NO = p.IPROM_NO AND dw.IPWRK_NO = ( SELECT MAX(dw2.IPWRK_NO) FROM TB_PROM_WRK dw2 WHERE dw2.IPROM_NO = p.IPROM_NO ) AND dw.SSTATUS IN ('편집중', '승인요청', '승인반려') ) ORDER BY p.ILAW_NO DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_PROM p WHERE p.IPROM_NO = #{promNo} AND COALESCE(p.SEXISTING_YN, 'N') = 'N' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_PROM_WRK dw WHERE dw.IPROM_NO = p.IPROM_NO AND dw.IPWRK_NO = ( SELECT MAX(dw2.IPWRK_NO) FROM TB_PROM_WRK dw2 WHERE dw2.IPROM_NO = p.IPROM_NO ) AND dw.SSTATUS IN ('편집중', '승인요청', '승인반려') )

SELECT TRIM(o.ORGNZT_ID) AS "orgnztId", o.ORGNZT_NM AS "buseoNm", COALESCE(o.ORGNZT_DC, o.ORGNZT_NM) AS "fullNm", CASE WHEN (o.ORGNZT_ID ~ '^ORG_[0-9]{16}$') THEN CAST(SUBSTR(o.ORGNZT_ID, 5) AS BIGINT) END AS "buseoNo" FROM COMTNORGNZTINFO o
WHERE UPPER(o.ORGNZT_NM) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%'
ORDER BY o.ORGNZT_NM
SELECT MAX(p.ILAW_NO) FROM TB_PROM p WHERE p.ILAW_ID = #{lawId} AND p.ILAW_NO <= #{lawNo} AND p.IGAEJUNG_NO IN ( SELECT g.IGAEJUNG_NO FROM TB_GAEJUNG g WHERE g.SDIFF_YN = 'N' AND g.SDEL_YN = 'N' )

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT , NULL AS CATE_NM, NULL AS CATE_FULL_NM, NULL AS BUSEO_NM FROM TB_PROM p WHERE p.ILAW_ID = (SELECT ILAW_ID FROM TB_PROM WHERE IPROM_NO = #{promNo}) AND p.IPROM_NO < #{promNo} ORDER BY p.IPROM_NO DESC ) X LIMIT 1
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(ILAW_ID), 0) + 1 FROM TB_PROM
SELECT MAX(ILAW_NO) FROM TB_PROM WHERE ILAW_ID = #{lawId}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(ISEQ), 0) + 1 FROM TB_PROM WHERE ICATE_NO = #{cateNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PROM ( IPROM_NO, SGUBUN_ID, ICATE_NO, IGAEJUNG_NO, SGAEJUNG_CODE, ILAW_ID, ILAW_NO, IBUSEO_NO, SBUSEO_ORGNZT_ID, STITLE, SSUB_TITLE, SNUM, SPARTY, SPROM_DT, SSTART_DT, SNULL_DT, SINS_DT, SREASON, SGAEJUNG, SBYLAW, SPREAMBLE, SSEARCH_TEXT, SURL, SPROV_FG, SPROV_STYLE_CD, SPROV_FILE_NO, SDISP_YN, SEXISTING_YN, SEXT_DISP_YN, SDPL_ITEM_YN, SREL_FILE_VIEW_YN, SSTSFDG_YN, SSTATUS, ISEQ, SORDERIDX ) VALUES ( #{promNo}, #{gubunId}, #{cateNo}, #{gaejungNo}, #{gaejungCode}, #{lawId}, #{lawNo}, #{buseoNo}, #{buseoOrgnztId}, #{title}, #{subTitle}, #{number}, #{party}, #{promDate}, #{startDate}, #{nullDate}, TO_CHAR(LOCALTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), #{reason}, #{gaejung}, #{bylaw}, #{preamble}, #{searchText}, #{url}, #{provFlag}, #{provStyleCd}, #{provFileNo}, #{dispYn}, #{existingYn}, #{extDispYn}, #{dplItemYn}, #{relFileViewYn}, #{stsfdgYn}, #{status}, #{seq}, #{orderIdx} )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_PROM SET SGUBUN_ID = #{gubunId}, ICATE_NO = #{cateNo}, IGAEJUNG_NO = #{gaejungNo}, SGAEJUNG_CODE = #{gaejungCode}, ILAW_ID = #{lawId}, ILAW_NO = #{lawNo}, IBUSEO_NO = #{buseoNo}, SBUSEO_ORGNZT_ID = #{buseoOrgnztId}, STITLE = #{title}, SSUB_TITLE = #{subTitle}, SNUM = #{number}, SPARTY = #{party}, SPROM_DT = #{promDate}, SSTART_DT = #{startDate}, SNULL_DT = #{nullDate}, SREASON = #{reason}, SGAEJUNG = #{gaejung}, SBYLAW = #{bylaw}, SPREAMBLE = #{preamble}, SSEARCH_TEXT = #{searchText}, SURL = #{url}, SPROV_FG = #{provFlag}, SPROV_STYLE_CD = #{provStyleCd}, SPROV_FILE_NO = #{provFileNo}, SDISP_YN = #{dispYn}, SEXISTING_YN = #{existingYn}, SEXT_DISP_YN = #{extDispYn}, SDPL_ITEM_YN = #{dplItemYn}, SREL_FILE_VIEW_YN = #{relFileViewYn}, SSTSFDG_YN = #{stsfdgYn}, SSTATUS = #{status}, ISEQ = #{seq}, SORDERIDX = #{orderIdx} WHERE IPROM_NO = #{promNo}
UPDATE TB_PROM SET SEXISTING_YN = #{existingYn} WHERE IPROM_NO = #{promNo}
UPDATE TB_PROM SET SEXISTING_YN = 'N' WHERE ILAW_ID = #{lawId}
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_PROV_VRSN WHERE IPROM_NO = #{promNo}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_PROV_HTML WHERE IPROM_NO = #{promNo}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_DOCU WHERE IPROM_NO = #{promNo}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_REL_VRSN WHERE IPROM_NO = #{promNo}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ATTACH WHERE COALESCE(SREF_TABLE,' ') = 'TB_PROM' AND IREF_NO = #{promNo}) AS CNT
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_PROM SET ISEQ = #{seq} WHERE IPROM_NO = #{promNo}
UPDATE TB_PROM SET ICATE_NO = #{cateNo} WHERE ILAW_ID = ( SELECT ILAW_ID FROM TB_PROM WHERE IPROM_NO = #{promNo} )
mapper.sql: AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_PROM_WRK dw WHERE dw.IPROM_NO = p.IPROM_NO AND dw.IPWRK_NO = ( SELECT MAX(dw2.IPWRK_NO) FROM TB_PROM_WRK dw2 WHERE dw2.IPROM_NO = p.IPROM_NO ) AND dw.SSTATUS IN ('편집중', '승인요청', '승인반려') )
AND ( p.SSTART_DT IS NULL OR TRIM(p.SSTART_DT) = '' OR p.SSTART_DT = '--' OR p.SSTART_DT <= TO_CHAR(LOCALTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD') )
AND ( p.SNULL_DT IS NULL OR TRIM(p.SNULL_DT) = '' OR p.SNULL_DT = '--' OR p.SNULL_DT >= TO_CHAR(LOCALTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD') )

( SELECT rk.ILAW_ID, rk.ICATE_NO CUR_CATE, rk.SGUBUN_ID CUR_GUBUN FROM ( SELECT pl.ILAW_ID, pl.ICATE_NO, pl.SGUBUN_ID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pl.ILAW_ID ORDER BY pl.ILAW_NO DESC, pl.IPROM_NO DESC) RNK FROM TB_PROM pl ) rk WHERE rk.RNK = 1 )

AND p.ILAW_ID NOT IN ( SELECT lcd.ILAW_ID FROM lcd WHERE lcd.CUR_CATE IN ( SELECT dtd.ICATE_NO FROM ( WITH RECURSIVE crd AS ( SELECT dd.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE dd WHERE dd.SDEL_YN = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT ch.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE ch JOIN crd ON ch.IREF = crd.ICATE_NO ) SELECT ICATE_NO FROM crd ) dtd ) )
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM COMTCCMMNDETAILCODE hg WHERE hg.CODE_ID = 'SGUBUN' AND hg.CODE = p.SGUBUN_ID AND hg.USE_AT = 'N' )

sql.if: AND ( p.ILAW_ID NOT IN ( SELECT lcr.ILAW_ID FROM lcr WHERE lcr.CUR_CATE IN ( SELECT rr.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE_READER rr UNION SELECT dt1.ICATE_NO FROM ( WITH RECURSIVE cr1 AS ( SELECT ca.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE ca WHERE ca.ICATE_NO IN ( SELECT r.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE_READER r WHERE r.INHERIT_YN = 'Y' ) UNION ALL SELECT ch.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE ch JOIN cr1 ON ch.IREF = cr1.ICATE_NO ) SELECT ICATE_NO FROM cr1 ) dt1 ) OR lcr.CUR_GUBUN IN ( SELECT gg.SGUBUN_ID FROM TB_GUBUN_READER gg ) ) OR p.ILAW_ID IN ( SELECT lca.ILAW_ID FROM lca WHERE lca.CUR_CATE IN ( SELECT rm.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE_READER rm WHERE ( ( rm.READER_TY = 'USER' AND rm.READER_ID = #{readerEsntlId} ) OR ( rm.READER_TY = 'DEPT' AND rm.READER_ID = #{readerOrgnztId} ) ) UNION SELECT dt2.ICATE_NO FROM ( WITH RECURSIVE cr2 AS ( SELECT cm.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE cm WHERE cm.ICATE_NO IN ( SELECT r2.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE_READER r2 WHERE r2.INHERIT_YN = 'Y' AND ( ( r2.READER_TY = 'USER' AND r2.READER_ID = #{readerEsntlId} ) OR ( r2.READER_TY = 'DEPT' AND r2.READER_ID = #{readerOrgnztId} ) ) ) UNION ALL SELECT ch.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE ch JOIN cr2 ON ch.IREF = cr2.ICATE_NO ) SELECT ICATE_NO FROM cr2 ) dt2 ) OR lca.CUR_GUBUN IN ( SELECT g2.SGUBUN_ID FROM TB_GUBUN_READER g2 WHERE ( ( g2.READER_TY = 'USER' AND g2.READER_ID = #{readerEsntlId} ) OR ( g2.READER_TY = 'DEPT' AND g2.READER_ID = #{readerOrgnztId} ) ) ) ) )

mapper.select:
SELECT , c.SNAME AS CATE_NM, GET_FULL_NAME_BY_CATE_NO('NONE', p.ICATE_NO) AS CATE_FULL_NM, b.ORGNZT_NM AS BUSEO_NM FROM TB_PROM p LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CATE c ON p.ICATE_NO = c.ICATE_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTNORGNZTINFO b ON b.ORGNZT_ID = COALESCE(p.SBUSEO_ORGNZT_ID, 'ORG_' || LPAD(CAST(p.IBUSEO_NO AS text), 16, '0')) WHERE p.SDISP_YN = 'Y'
ORDER BY p.ILAW_ID DESC, p.ILAW_NO DESC, p.SPROM_DT DESC LIMIT #{recordCountPerPage} OFFSET #{firstIndex}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_PROM p LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CATE c ON p.ICATE_NO = c.ICATE_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTNORGNZTINFO b ON b.ORGNZT_ID = COALESCE(p.SBUSEO_ORGNZT_ID, 'ORG_' || LPAD(CAST(p.IBUSEO_NO AS text), 16, '0')) WHERE p.SDISP_YN = 'Y'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_PROM p LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CATE c ON p.ICATE_NO = c.ICATE_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTNORGNZTINFO b ON b.ORGNZT_ID = COALESCE(p.SBUSEO_ORGNZT_ID, 'ORG_' || LPAD(CAST(p.IBUSEO_NO AS text), 16, '0')) WHERE p.SDISP_YN = 'Y' AND (p.SNULL_DT IS NOT NULL AND p.SNULL_DT != '--' AND TRIM(p.SNULL_DT) != '')

SELECT , c.SNAME AS CATE_NM, GET_FULL_NAME_BY_CATE_NO('NONE', p.ICATE_NO) AS CATE_FULL_NM, b.ORGNZT_NM AS BUSEO_NM FROM TB_PROM p LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CATE c ON p.ICATE_NO = c.ICATE_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTNORGNZTINFO b ON b.ORGNZT_ID = COALESCE(p.SBUSEO_ORGNZT_ID, 'ORG_' || LPAD(CAST(p.IBUSEO_NO AS text), 16, '0')) WHERE p.SDISP_YN = 'Y' AND p.SEXISTING_YN = 'Y' AND TO_TIMESTAMP(p.SINS_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') >= LOCALTIMESTAMP - make_interval(days => CAST(#{searchDays} AS int))
ORDER BY p.SINS_DT DESC, p.IPROM_NO DESC LIMIT #{recordCountPerPage} OFFSET #{firstIndex}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_PROM p LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CATE c ON p.ICATE_NO = c.ICATE_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTNORGNZTINFO b ON b.ORGNZT_ID = COALESCE(p.SBUSEO_ORGNZT_ID, 'ORG_' || LPAD(CAST(p.IBUSEO_NO AS text), 16, '0')) WHERE p.SDISP_YN = 'Y' AND p.SEXISTING_YN = 'Y' AND TO_TIMESTAMP(p.SINS_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') >= LOCALTIMESTAMP - make_interval(days => CAST(#{searchDays} AS int))

SELECT , c.SNAME AS CATE_NM, GET_FULL_NAME_BY_CATE_NO('NONE', p.ICATE_NO) AS CATE_FULL_NM, b.ORGNZT_NM AS BUSEO_NM FROM TB_PROM p LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CATE c ON p.ICATE_NO = c.ICATE_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTNORGNZTINFO b ON b.ORGNZT_ID = COALESCE(p.SBUSEO_ORGNZT_ID, 'ORG_' || LPAD(CAST(p.IBUSEO_NO AS text), 16, '0')) WHERE p.SDISP_YN = 'Y' AND p.SEXISTING_YN = 'Y'
ORDER BY p.SGUBUN_ID, c.IREF, c.ISEQ, p.ISEQ, p.IPROM_NO LIMIT #{recordCountPerPage} OFFSET #{firstIndex}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_PROM p LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CATE c ON p.ICATE_NO = c.ICATE_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTNORGNZTINFO b ON b.ORGNZT_ID = COALESCE(p.SBUSEO_ORGNZT_ID, 'ORG_' || LPAD(CAST(p.IBUSEO_NO AS text), 16, '0')) WHERE p.SDISP_YN = 'Y' AND p.SEXISTING_YN = 'Y'

sql.if: AND p.ICATE_NO IN ( WITH RECURSIVE crc AS ( SELECT ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE WHERE ICATE_NO = #{cateNo} UNION ALL SELECT ch.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE ch JOIN crc ON ch.IREF = crc.ICATE_NO ) SELECT ICATE_NO FROM crc )

AND ( 1 = 0
OR UPPER(REPLACE(p.STITLE, ' ', '')) LIKE '%' || UPPER(REPLACE(#{searchKeyword}, ' ', '')) || '%'
OR UPPER(REPLACE(p.SPARTY, ' ', '')) LIKE '%' || UPPER(REPLACE(#{searchKeyword}, ' ', '')) || '%'
OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_SRC_STORED s WHERE s.ILAW_ID = p.ILAW_ID AND s.SFLAG = '조문' AND ( STRPOS(s.SCONTENTS, #{searchKeyword}) > 0 OR UPPER(REPLACE(s.SFULL_TITLE, ' ', '')) LIKE '%' || UPPER(REPLACE(#{searchKeyword}, ' ', '')) || '%' ) )
OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_SRC_STORED s WHERE s.ILAW_ID = p.ILAW_ID AND s.SFLAG = '서식' AND ( STRPOS(s.SCONTENTS, #{searchKeyword}) > 0 OR UPPER(REPLACE(s.SFULL_TITLE, ' ', '')) LIKE '%' || UPPER(REPLACE(#{searchKeyword}, ' ', '')) || '%' ) )
)

mapper.select:
SELECT , c.SNAME AS CATE_NM, GET_FULL_NAME_BY_CATE_NO('NONE', p.ICATE_NO) AS CATE_FULL_NM, b.ORGNZT_NM AS BUSEO_NM FROM TB_PROM p LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CATE c ON p.ICATE_NO = c.ICATE_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTNORGNZTINFO b ON b.ORGNZT_ID = COALESCE(p.SBUSEO_ORGNZT_ID, 'ORG_' || LPAD(CAST(p.IBUSEO_NO AS text), 16, '0')) WHERE p.SDISP_YN = 'Y'
ORDER BY p.SGUBUN_ID, c.IREF, c.ISEQ, p.ISEQ, p.IPROM_NO LIMIT #{recordCountPerPage} OFFSET #{firstIndex}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_PROM p WHERE p.SDISP_YN = 'Y'

SELECT DISTINCT p.IBUSEO_NO AS "buseoNo", b.ORGNZT_NM AS "buseoNm" FROM TB_PROM p JOIN COMTNORGNZTINFO b ON b.ORGNZT_ID = COALESCE(p.SBUSEO_ORGNZT_ID, 'ORG_' || LPAD(CAST(p.IBUSEO_NO AS text), 16, '0')) WHERE p.SEXISTING_YN = 'Y' AND p.IBUSEO_NO IS NOT NULL AND b.ORGNZT_NM IS NOT NULL ORDER BY b.ORGNZT_NM

WITH RECURSIVE ct AS ( SELECT ICATE_NO, SGUBUN_ID, SNAME, SDEL_YN, 1 AS LVL, CAST(LPAD(CAST(COALESCE(ISEQ,999999) AS text), 6, '0') AS TEXT) AS SPATH FROM TB_CATE WHERE (IREF = 0 OR IREF IS NULL) UNION ALL SELECT c.ICATE_NO, c.SGUBUN_ID, c.SNAME, c.SDEL_YN, ct.LVL + 1, CONCAT(ct.SPATH, '/', LPAD(CAST(COALESCE(c.ISEQ,999999) AS text), 6, '0')) FROM TB_CATE c JOIN ct ON c.IREF = ct.ICATE_NO ) SELECT ICATE_NO AS "cateNo", SGUBUN_ID AS "gubunId", LPAD(' ', (LVL-1)*3, ' ') || SNAME AS "cateNm", LVL AS "lvl" FROM ct WHERE SDEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY SPATH

SELECT , NULL AS CATE_NM, NULL AS CATE_FULL_NM, NULL AS BUSEO_NM FROM TB_PROM p WHERE p.ILAW_ID = #{lawId}
ORDER BY p.ILAW_NO DESC, p.SPROM_DT DESC
SELECT , NULL AS CATE_NM, NULL AS CATE_FULL_NM, NULL AS BUSEO_NM FROM TB_PROM p WHERE p.SEXISTING_YN = 'Y' AND p.SDISP_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY p.IPROM_NO

SELECT p.IPROM_NO, p.ILAW_ID, p.STITLE, p.SSUB_TITLE, p.ICATE_NO, p.SGUBUN_ID, c.SNAME AS CATE_NM FROM TB_PROM p LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CATE c ON p.ICATE_NO = c.ICATE_NO WHERE p.SEXISTING_YN = 'Y' AND p.SDISP_YN = 'Y'

SELECT , c.SNAME AS CATE_NM, GET_FULL_NAME_BY_CATE_NO('NONE', p.ICATE_NO) AS CATE_FULL_NM, b.ORGNZT_NM AS BUSEO_NM FROM TB_PROM p LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CATE c ON p.ICATE_NO = c.ICATE_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTNORGNZTINFO b ON b.ORGNZT_ID = COALESCE(p.SBUSEO_ORGNZT_ID, 'ORG_' || LPAD(CAST(p.IBUSEO_NO AS text), 16, '0')) WHERE p.SEXISTING_YN = 'Y' AND p.ICATE_NO = #{cateNo} ORDER BY p.ISEQ, p.SORDERIDX, p.IPROM_NO
SELECT , NULL AS CATE_NM, NULL AS CATE_FULL_NM, NULL AS BUSEO_NM FROM TB_PROM p WHERE p.SEXISTING_YN = 'Y' AND p.SDISP_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY p.ICATE_NO, p.ISEQ, p.SPROM_DT DESC, p.IPROM_NO DESC

SELECT , NULL AS CATE_NM, NULL AS CATE_FULL_NM, b.ORGNZT_NM AS BUSEO_NM FROM TB_PROM p LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTNORGNZTINFO b ON b.ORGNZT_ID = COALESCE(p.SBUSEO_ORGNZT_ID, 'ORG_' || LPAD(CAST(p.IBUSEO_NO AS text), 16, '0')) WHERE p.SEXISTING_YN = 'Y' AND p.SDISP_YN = 'Y'
ORDER BY b.ORGNZT_NM IS NULL, b.ORGNZT_NM, p.STITLE, p.IPROM_NO

SELECT p.IPROM_NO AS "promNo", p.ILAW_ID AS "lawId", p.STITLE AS "title", p.SPROM_DT AS "promDate", w.SSTATUS AS "status", w.SUSER_NM AS "userNm", SUBSTR(w.SINS_DT, 1, 16) AS "workDt", c.SNAME AS "cateNm" FROM TB_PROM p JOIN TB_PROM_WRK w ON w.IPROM_NO = p.IPROM_NO AND w.IPWRK_NO = ( SELECT MAX(w2.IPWRK_NO) FROM TB_PROM_WRK w2 WHERE w2.IPROM_NO = p.IPROM_NO ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CATE c ON c.ICATE_NO = p.ICATE_NO WHERE p.SEXISTING_YN = 'N' AND p.SDISP_YN = 'Y' AND w.SSTATUS IN ('편집중', '승인요청', '승인반려') ORDER BY w.SINS_DT DESC

SELECT , NULL AS CATE_NM, NULL AS CATE_FULL_NM, NULL AS BUSEO_NM FROM TB_PROM p WHERE p.SEXISTING_YN = 'N' AND p.SDISP_YN = 'Y' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_PROM cur WHERE cur.ILAW_ID = p.ILAW_ID AND cur.SEXISTING_YN = 'Y' AND cur.SDISP_YN = 'Y' ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_PROM_WRK w WHERE w.IPROM_NO = p.IPROM_NO AND w.IPWRK_NO = ( SELECT MAX(w2.IPWRK_NO) FROM TB_PROM_WRK w2 WHERE w2.IPROM_NO = p.IPROM_NO ) AND w.SSTATUS IN ('편집중', '승인요청', '승인반려') ) AND p.IPROM_NO = ( SELECT MAX(p2.IPROM_NO) FROM TB_PROM p2 WHERE p2.ILAW_ID = p.ILAW_ID AND p2.SEXISTING_YN = 'N' AND p2.SDISP_YN = 'Y' ) ORDER BY p.ICATE_NO, p.ISEQ, p.SPROM_DT DESC, p.IPROM_NO DESC
